niche.habitat: Valley edges, meadow borders, raiding routes, and near carcass drift lines.
niche.diet: Carnivore: flesh, bone, chitin, and scavenged meat.
niche.active: Diurnal, opportunistic raider; peaks during evening storms or fog breaks.

body: Low-slung raider with a short, wide skull built for crushing bone and chitin, and powerful hip joints that power short, explosive bursts through dense air. Their ragged, low-frequency call acts as an acoustic jammer to interrupt rival courtship, while an elastic throat sac delivers a deimatic startle boom.

chains.trait: Short, wide skull crushes bone and chitin
links: Carcasses drift ashore and marrow is fiercely contested (F20, F26)
Rapidly fracturing bone and chitin wins the meal before rivals arrive (F4)
High pO₂ supports dense jaw muscles and a tall coronoid process for quick snaps (F5)
Shattering Espinodo plates is a tactical payoff, not the evolutionary driver

skill.effect: Deals 18 damage, ignores 50% armour (bone and Espinodo plates only), 0.4 s audio click and forward lunge telegraph the strike, 0.8 s wind-up, 4 s cooldown.

chains.weakness: The 0.4 s click and head drop telegraph the lunge; sidestep and strike the exposed flank for +25% damage.

journal.en: It bites like it is breaking a shell.

analogues.organism: Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta): hypertrophied cranial musculature and dentition for crushing bone and shell (Van Valkenburgh & Hertel, carnivoran bite-force literature, from memory unverified); elevated pO₂ on Primigenia (F5) matches Earth highland/large-predator aerobic jaw budgets.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Low-slung hips power short burst raids
links: Raids win by ambush and theft, never by long chases
1.6× drag punishes tall, frontal bodies and caps sprints to a few seconds
1.05 g makes each stride costly, so power sits in the hips and elastic tendons, not long limbs
Gales at 1.6× wind force weed out tall, light builds on the open east meadows

skill.effect: From a belly-low crouch, bursts to 14 m/s for 3 s (~40 m) while the stamina bar visibly drains; then speed drops 40% for 8 s with a buckling-knees animation.

chains.weakness: The crouch start telegraphs the burst: hover just outside reach for 3 s, then strike while its knees buckle and the stamina bar refills; broken ground still kills its cornering.
observe: Coiled stillness, then 3 heartbeats of speed
Buckling knees and heaving chest after

journal.en: Three heartbeats of courage, then arithmetic.

analogues.organism: Wolverine (Gulo gulo) and similar mustelids: low, power-forward chassis, short explosive charges and theft/ambush rather than cursorial pursuit—fits 1.6× aerodynamic drag and brief sprint caps (F4) plus 1.05 g stride cost (F2).
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Ragged, low-frequency call interrupts rival displays
links: Steals mates and food from distracted targets
Dense air carries low-frequency interruptions across the fog trap
Morning fog and temperature inversions duct sound, making acoustic dominance critical

skill.effect: Interrupts courtship or ritual within 30 m for 5 s; target loses 10 befriend.

chains.weakness: Two courting creatures can mob it; bring a partner and it flees after 4 s.

journal.en: It is the reason courtship has witnesses.

plausibility.summary: Anchor the heckle in ~80–250 Hz (or brief infrasonic pulses): F4/F8 duct low frequencies in fog; a ragged high call would not carry or dominate and would contradict canon sensory ecology.
fixes: Anchor the heckle in ~80–250 Hz (or brief infrasonic pulses): F4/F8 duct low frequencies in fog; a ragged high call would not carry or dominate and would contradict canon sensory ecology.

analogues.organism: Howler monkeys (Alouatta): low-frequency, long-range social/vocal contest in forest acoustics; lek and chorus frogs: call overlap and acoustic masking in dense soundscapes (Wells, frog behavioral ecology, from memory unverified)—mechanism is interference and attention theft, not mimetic deceit.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

chains.trait: Elastic throat sac booms a deimatic startle
links: Humid air (F15) causes condensation rings when the sac rapidly inflates
Sudden low-frequency boom triggers a flinch reflex in pose-reading rivals within 10 m
Elastic recoil and dense atmosphere couple the sound efficiently without tissue damage (F4)
High pO₂ funds the rapid recovery phase after the single inflation (F5)

skill.effect: Inflates throat sac: visible condensation ring expands to 40 m; pose-reading creatures within 10 m flinch and cancel one action for 1.5 s. Costs 15% stamina, applies 50% speed reduction to self for 3 s.

chains.weakness: The expanding ring telegraphs the 40 m cone; stand outside it to avoid the flinch, then strike during the 3 s speed penalty.
observe: Spined crest rises with the pose
Throat sac balloons in one blink
Condensation ring marks the boom's cone

journal.en: It answers every pose with a bigger one.

plausibility.summary: Keep the boom deimatic only: no tissue injury; 6 s exhausted recovery after a single inflation matches elastic-sac physiology—do not treat it like a repeatable spammable weapon without metabolic cost.
fixes: Keep the boom deimatic only: no tissue injury; 6 s exhausted recovery after a single inflation matches elastic-sac physiology—do not treat it like a repeatable spammable weapon without metabolic cost.

analogues.organism: Howler monkey enlarged hyoid + vocal tract for sudden low-frequency roars; sage grouse (Centrocercus) and many anurans: air-sac inflation as startle/ritual escalation (honest costly signal; Zahavi handicap principle, from memory unverified)—dense air (F4) increases near-field acoustic coupling for the same sac volume.
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

temperament: Aggressive heckler that thrives on chaos and interrupts social displays to create raiding opportunities.
moments: A ragged boom that shatters a Rondo's courtship song, drawing the herd's attention while the Garfio flanks.
A low-slung sprint that kicks up dust and grass, ending in a bone-crushing bite.
A deimatic throat-puff that startles a Zanco into a fatal misstep on the scree.
